messages:
Priya: FYI incoming from CorpEx — they got invoice INV-2026-9973 but PO number is missing. They're blocking payment reconciliation for Q1 close. Customer insists PO must be on invoice (PO-887204).
Sam: Can you paste the invoice preview or invoice JSON? Also do we have a payment on that invoice?
Priya: Invoice snippet:
```
{ "invoice_id": "INV-2026-9973", "amount": 24,350.00, "status": "paid", "metadata": {}}
```
Payment: charged yesterday via card ending ****4242, capture confirmed.
Sam: OK — since it's paid, we can't just PATCH metadata and have AR record it. Two options: 1) issue a credit memo and create a new invoice with the PO, then apply the credit; 2) refund the card and reissue the invoice with PO then re-collect. Which path does CorpEx prefer?
Priya: They asked for "reissue with PO, apply credit so ledger is clean" — they don't want a refund on their end. They prefer credit + rebill.
Jared: For audit trail, finance prefers: create a full credit (credit memo) for INV-2026-9973, create new invoice INV-2026-9973-R1 with PO-887204, then apply the credit against the new invoice so net is zero and we don't touch the customer's refund flow. Note: if customer already closed their payment batch, they may still expect a refund; communicate clearly.
Morgan: Technically: our Billing API supports creating a credit memo and new invoice. Quick steps for support to run (needs billing-admin role):
1) POST /v1/invoices/INV-2026-9973/credits {"amount":24350, "reason":"PO missing - reissue"}
2) POST /v1/invoices {"customer_id":"corpex-001","items": [...], "metadata":{"po_number":"PO-887204"}, "reference":"INV-2026-9973-R1"}
3) POST /v1/credits/apply {"credit_id":"<id>", "invoice_id":"INV-2026-9973-R1"}
Example curl for 1):
```
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/v1/invoices/INV-2026-9973/credits \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"amount":24350, "reason":"PO missing - reissue"}'
```
Priya: Do we need customer sign-off for the credit? They already asked for reissue with PO.
Jared: Yes get explicit approval via email thread — attach the new invoice draft. Also capture ack that they accept credit memo instead of refund. Record in ticket.
Sam: I'll prepare the credit memo draft. Quick checks: confirm tax lines (VAT) copied to new invoice exactly. If tax calculation changed, we must adjust before applying credit.
Priya: Tax is identical per their AR team — VAT 20%. I have email from corpex.ar@example.com confirming.
InvoiceBot: Automated notice — Credit memo created: CM-7791 (created by Sam).
Sam: Created CM-7791 for 24350.00. Next creating new invoice INV-2026-9973-R1 with PO-887204 and attaching email consent.
Priya: Sent draft to customer for final OK.
CorpEx (via Priya): "Confirming approval to accept credit memo and receive reissued invoice with PO-887204. No refund requested."
Jared: OK finance will reconcile once credit applied. Note: this will show on next statement as applied credit; our AR system will mark original invoice as credited.
Morgan: After credit applied, make sure to call the ledger /audit export endpoint and attach export to the ticket for auditors: GET /v1/accounts/corpex-001/ledger?from=2026-03-01&to=2026-03-31
Sam: Action items: Sam -> create credit + new invoice (in progress). Priya -> attach corpex approval and verify VAT lines. Jared -> reconcile and close ticket after ledger export. Morgan -> stand by if API errors.
Priya: ETA to customer: 48 hours. I'll update ticket.
Sam: Done — new invoice INV-2026-9973-R1 created, credit applied. Linking transaction IDs in the support ticket.
InvoiceBot: System update — Invoice INV-2026-9973 status: credited; Invoice INV-2026-9973-R1 status: paid (payment applied via credit).
Jared: Closing loop — no refunds issued, ledger balanced. Marking this as resolved from finance side. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Thanks team — I'll confirm with CorpEx that they can reconcile. Closing the support thread after customer ack.
note: thread represents a single Slack conversation about a paid invoice missing PO and the credit/reissue workflow
